n: Creative Coding through Digital Storytelling (SD38 grades 1-3)
t: A district report of grades 1 to 3 students making animated stories in ScratchJr.
steps: Find the Richmond school district news article about creative coding.
Ask IT to install the app.
Try ScratchJr yourself and make a short animation.
Plan a story theme for your class.
Plan a multi-lesson unit. The article does not give a number.
Share finished stories with the class.
